source.scope: New selected-suite, exact CI compiler-control and emitted-assembly evidence. Previously closed source, original, default and public-authority reviews are reused; no product edits, builds, tests, campaigns or nested agents were performed.

decision.summary: Three measured code-generation sites justify a focused numerical implementation. Keep the canonical original Win64 word/action contract, oracle, targets, flags, clamps and formulas unchanged. Capture and variant restoration are now evidenced; they do not make the failing arithmetic conformant.

inspected_facts: Independently checked all four literal CI diagnostic blocks, their seven reported source hashes against frozen Git blobs, all 27 sweep diagnostics and the 261-natural-input summaries. Complete diagnostics precede the unchanged first oracle assertion: failing jobs expose all 288 diagnostic inputs but do not complete every 288-row assertion after that first failure.

Each CI block reports complete capture, 1152 separately bracketed U/d,U/c,S/d,S/c runs and zero post-restoration readback mismatches. Canonical entry is x87 CW 0x0f7f / MXCSR 0x7f80. CW/SW/TW and complete MXCSR are measured; restored environment pointers are not compared, data registers and other threads are outside the claim.

Independently checked artifact sizes and hashes in both selected-platform directories against the assessment, actual controller/test exits, complete capture and 1152/zero restoration results. Both pinned platforms pass kernel/control 3 tests, all 288 exact word/action rows, and witness 12 tests.

Both i686 variants have exactly FD1 and FD12 kernel mismatches; Wine has exactly FD7; the passing x64-labelled-OPT2 job has none. All four retain zero natural-input kernel differences. Default-rounding surrogate differences are separate diagnostic observations, never alternate goldens.

The i686 instruction/constant listings agree across ordinary and original-stack jobs after accounting, for analysis only, for two explicit interleaved test-status lines in one listing. Literal timestamped evidence remains untouched; whole blocks are not claimed byte-identical.

U retains original arithmetic statements in a surrogate context with stub collaborators/reduced layouts, not the complete original engine's code generation. S changes code through marked volatile stages and an extra magnitude call; notably it does not stage the first FD12 right-pitch assignment.

Exact current CI receipt has three completed workflows and seven campaign jobs: six of nine total jobs succeed and three numerical jobs fail. The x64 default Lints step succeeds. Earlier lint/Wine-positive-control failures remain retained historical failures.

compiler_identity.qualification: Machine triple alone does not make the output 64-bit. Both records contain actual 32-bit target facts and x87 code.
These are measured compiler strings/macros. They do not establish an exact 13.2 package/compiler identity.

findings.group: Original stored precision and runtime-rounded saturated arithmetic

sites.location: eech-campaign/crates/eech-world/csrc/env_ref.c:2246-2248,2329; emitted env_ref_rotor_sound .L778/.L720 in both i686 records
sites.case: FD1 amp0 expected 0x3f2aaaab, actual 0x3f2aaaaa; U/c and S/c match expected.
sites.evidence: Kernel calls rotor_vector_magnitude then fdivs(15.0), fmuls(loop level), clamp comparisons and keeps the resulting x87 value through fsub for LOOPING-minus-SLAP. Final outputs are narrowed with fstps only afterwards. U spills the value with fsts to -40(%ebp) before later collaborator calls, and subtracts that stored value with fsubs. Both output slap words are 0x3eaaaaaa; the subtraction consumed different intermediate precision. Magnitude is exactly 5 in this case; both actual magnitude helpers use compatible x87 multiply/add/sqrt and return ST0.
sites.requirement: Enforce the original float-assignment boundary before slap participates in LOOPING-minus-SLAP; preserve assignment/clamp/action order and canonical guard. Do not infer a vector-magnitude algorithm change from this exact-5 case.

sites.location: eech-campaign/crates/eech-world/csrc/env_ref.c:2276-2277; tests/csrc/rotor_control_body.h:122-124; emitted i686 kernel .L708 and U/S bodies
sites.case: FD12 right pitch3 expected 0x3f8e147a, actual 0x3f8e147b; U/c and S/c also differ.
sites.evidence: Input right RPM is 0x424c0001. i686 executes fdivs(100.0), bound comparisons and faddl(0.6) without narrowing the first right_turbine_pitch assignment; fstps follows the addition. S's STAGE(11) is after the second assignment, so S does not test the missing first boundary. Passing SSE code executes divss first, then cvtss2sd, bound/addsd and final cvtsd2ss.
sites.requirement: Enforce the first right_turbine_pitch float assignment after rrpm/100.0 before bound-plus-0.6. The evidence does not require changing global x87 precision or attributing this case to an untested double-excess-precision remedy.

sites.location: eech-campaign/crates/eech-world/csrc/env_ref.c:2292; emitted Windows kernel .L446/.LC70, passing Linux x64 bound/add path
sites.case: FD7 APU pitch4 expected 0x400ccccc, actual 0x400ccccd; U/c and S/c also differ.
sites.evidence: The Windows saturated branch loads movss .LC70, whose .long 1074580685 is 0x400ccccd. It bypasses the runtime bound-plus-0.2 addition and conversion, so the requested rounding mode cannot affect that constant. The passing Linux x64 branch selects the 2.0 double bound, executes addsd(0.2) and cvtsd2ss under the canonical environment. U/S reproduce the compiler fold; this is not evidence of a Wine FP-restoration defect.
sites.requirement: Ensure the selected saturated bound plus the original 0.2 executes and narrows at runtime inside the existing canonical guard. Do not hardcode an oracle word, change constants/clamps or add global numerical compiler flags.

findings.acceptance_constraint: One focused implementation turn may proceed. Preserve integer ingress/egress, full-state guard, formulas, original operation order and every existing assertion/seed/target. P1 closes only after review of changed source and actual exact-word/action/FP gates on the previously failing compilers, alongside required current CI and appropriate existing conformance gates.

additional_gate_results.Wine_positive_control: Actual job 124824088786 independently read from GitHub logs: deliberate divide-by-zero observation and enabled-trap witness both pass; the env_rotor_host_witness executable passes 12/12 at 10:43:01Z. Kernel later fails the unchanged FD7 assertion, job exit 101. No arbitrary Wine exit was accepted.
additional_gate_results.strict: Exact source38 x64 default CI succeeds including cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings. This closes the earlier test-lint follow-up for this head; failed numerical jobs do not imply their skipped Lints steps ran.

limitations: No actual same-target complete original-engine replay is claimed from U/S. The accepted canonical original Win64 oracle remains the contract; measured compiler alternatives are not replacements.

Capture assembly uses the same recorded source/settings with -S -g0; no claim of whole executable disassembly identity. Entry, actual callees/clones and constant pools were inspected; transient test-output interleavings were disclosed.

Readback proves the bounded control's declared thread environment restoration, not global engine startup precision, full public C/Lua FP equivalence, x87/XMM data-register preservation, other threads or audio behavior.

Prior original/default/authority acceptance scopes remain separate. No new retail run, shipping/Tacview proof, full sound ownership, whole Task51/D3 acceptance, publication or normal merge is conferred.
